Elena — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers below and a proposed next step. Attaching a redline of Redwood_DPA_v3 that incorporates the SCC clauses we typically surface in EU contracts.

- EU SCCs: Redwood usually provides our DPA with the current EU SCCs text incorporated (we keep an operational mapping to the 2021 SCCs). The attached redline shows the exact clauses we propose; happy to accept Novamed's counterchanges if needed.

- UK IDTA / Addendum: We can sign the UK Addendum version of the IDTA. Our preferred approach is to execute Redwood's standard addendum and accept a small number of targeted redlines (data residency carveouts or controller-specific responsibilities).

- TIA / DTIA: For typical production integrations we support time-limited access by our ops team under documented escalation procedures. Key safeguards: enforced role-based access, dedicated audit trail for any access to identifiable datasets, 30-day retention for full access logs by default (longer windows negotiable), and encryption at rest/in transit. We'll produce a short TIA summary for Novamed's security team.

- Escrow for audit logs: Redwood has participated in neutral escrow arrangements for limited customers (mostly large regulated customers). Common pattern: escrow agent holds encrypted logs for a defined retention period accessible only under agreed triggers (bankruptcy, legal hold). Setup usually takes 4-6 weeks after commercial signoff; we factor in legal/technical onboarding and verification.

Next steps: review the attached Redwood_DPA_v3_redline.pdf and the subprocessor list I'm pulling from infra (will share shortly). If Novamed is comfortable, we can run a short call with legal and security — I'm available Wednesday morning (07/11) or Thursday afternoon (07/12).

Chloe — forwarding a couple of operational notes for Elena and legal: attaching current subprocessor_list.csv and a short technical note on log escrow feasibility. Key points for procurement:

- Subprocessors: most are cloud infra + tracing providers. We can provide per-region routing commitments but cannot guarantee single-country-only processing unless on Redwood Private (on-prem / VPC).
- Audit logs & escrow: we can extract system-level audit logs (access events, job IDs, timestamps) and produce an encrypted bundle for escrow. We do not typically escrow content-level payloads for hosted customers due to size and privacy considerations; that would need bespoke work and cost pass-through.
- TIA scoping: ops access requires a written request, two-person approval, and a short-lived privileged token. All privileged actions are logged and retained for 30 days by default. We can extend retention to 90/180 days for regulated customers.
